item.description: টোকিওস্থ বাংলাদেশ মিশনে আয়োজিত এক ব্রিফিংয়ে পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী এই বক্তব্য প্রদান করেন। প্রধানমন্ত্রীর জাপান ভ্রমণ কেন্দ্র করে উক্ত সংবাদ সম্মেলনের আয়োজন করা হয়েছিল।

item.description: মানিক পশারীর শেষকৃত্য পালনে প্রতিবন্ধকতা তৈরির সমালোচনা করেছেন নাহিদ ইসলাম। তিনি সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে এক বার্তায় জানান, শেষ বিদায়ের আচার অনুষ্ঠান সম্পাদন করা মানবজাতি ও ধর্মের মৌলিক অধিকার। ওই প্রসঙ্গে কথা বলতে গিয়ে তিনি সাবেক ক্ষমতাসীন দলের শাসনকালের প্রেক্ষাপটও উল্লেখ করেন।

item.title: Lula secures fourth presidential victory in Brazilian vote
item.description: Brazil's left-leaning leader secured a fourth presidential mandate following a close electoral race. This result comes after he previously trailed behind conservative rival Flávio Bolsonaro during the opening voting phase.

item.title: ব্যালন ডি’অর আয়োজনে লন্ডনে তারকা ফুটবলারদের মেলবন্ধন
item.description: লন্ডনে আয়োজিত বর্ষসেরা ফুটবলারের পুরস্কার প্রদান অনুষ্ঠানে সমবেত হয়েছেন বিশ্বের নামীদামি খেলোয়াড়েরা। সহধর্মিণীকে নিয়ে সেখানে হাজির হন বায়ার্ন মিউনিখের ফরোয়ার্ড হ্যারি কেইন, যা নিয়ে উপস্থিত দর্শকদের মধ্যে ট্রফি জয় সংক্রান্ত জল্পনা ছড়িয়ে পড়ে। পূর্বে সেখানে উপস্থিত হন মেসি, এমবাপ্পে ও ইয়ামাল।

item.title: Australian political developments: Greens propose ban on corporate funding
item.description: Senator Lambie expects an apology from Hanson over a controversial cartoon, while a Liberal candidate's spouse was reportedly assaulted. Meanwhile, the Victorian Greens are committing to institute a public lobbyist log and outlaw political contributions from large corporate entities.

item.title: French student activists call for continued school blockades
item.description: Student representatives in France have asked pupils to maintain school blockades and join public demonstrations following recent government actions. The organizers insist that demonstrations must persist until key issues regarding facility maintenance and staff deficits are fully addressed.

item.title: Authorities back E100 flex-fuel automobiles prior to market debut
item.description: Government regulators have granted policy support for E100 flex-fuel transport options before their official commercial release. This move facilitates the upcoming rollout of vehicles powered entirely by ethanol blends.

item.title: Dozens injured as vehicle rolls down slope close to Barcelona
item.description: A road accident near Barcelona left eighty individuals hurt when a passenger bus tumbled off a steep incline. Emergency services responded to the site following the vehicle's descent down the embankment.

item.title: Supreme Court Rules Karnataka Can Take Land Solely for Public Needs
item.description: The Supreme Court has reinstated a piece of land in Karnataka. It ruled that the state may only take private property when there is a clear public purpose.

item.title: Supreme Court Lawyers Apologize for Contempt Over Tribunal Remarks
item.description: Two attorneys sought forgiveness at the International Crimes Tribunal on Monday. They faced allegations of contempt for remarks concerning a verdict against Obaidul Quader and others.

item.title: High Court Petition Seeks End to Illegal Padma River Sand Mining
item.description: A lawyer filed a writ petition on behalf of a human rights organization. The filing aims to halt illicit sand dredging from the Padma River to protect the bridge structure and local ecology.

item.title: Judge Rules Maurene Comey Was Unlawfully Dismissed
item.description: A federal judge concluded that James Comey's daughter was fired improperly. Maurene Comey suspects her termination as a prosecutor stemmed from her father's former role as FBI director.

item.title: Hal Fashion Partners With Annex Communication to Boost Business
item.description: Digital lifestyle and beauty publication Hal Fashion has inked an agreement with Annex Communications. The partnership aims to enhance the brand's marketing efforts and commercial success.

item.title: Media Association Considers Supreme Court Challenge Against DPDP Act
item.description: A press organization may petition the Supreme Court regarding the DPDP Act. The body argues the legislation infringes upon freedom of speech and endangers independent journalism.

item.title: Dictionary.com Names 'Maxxing' the Word of the Year
item.description: Dictionary.com has chosen 'maxxing' as its top term for the year. Linguists note the abbreviation for maximizing reflects a cultural drive to push activities to their limits.

item.title: Macklemore Launches 'Free Palestine' Tour Following Ed Sheeran Split
item.description: Macklemore is launching a concert tour next month in Dublin. He stated that the proceeds will benefit organizations aiding Palestinians following his fallout with Ed Sheeran.

item.title: Former Tamil Nadu Minister Anbil Sent to Judicial Custody
item.description: Chennai law enforcement detained the ex-School Education Minister following the denial of his anticipatory bail. He faces allegations tied to a massive financial extortion scheme targeting private school operators.

item.title: Three Detained in Jordan Following Deadly Church Assault
item.description: Security forces in Jordan have taken three family members into custody. The arrests follow a fatal incident at a church in Karak that resulted in eight fatalities.

item.title: Syrian Higher Education Restrictions Bar Women From Certain Fields
item.description: Higher education institutions in Syria have barred female students from specific degree programs, sparking public discussion. Opponents express concern that this policy indicates potential rollbacks on women's freedoms by the incoming administration.

item.title: Birla States Legislative Bodies Can Help Reduce International Friction
item.description: According to Birla, legislative institutions have the capacity to act as connectors for diminishing worldwide conflicts.

item.title: Early Complaints Emerge Over Fractured Displays on New Apple Foldable
item.description: Initial buyers of Apple's highly anticipated foldable smartphone have reported issues with fragile displays breaking. These complaints highlight growing dissatisfaction among a segment of early consumers.

item.title: Reviewing Harry Kane's Top Bundesliga Goals Ahead of Ballon d'Or
item.description: Ahead of the upcoming 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony, sports coverage highlights standout goals scored by Harry Kane while playing for Bayern Munich.

item.title: Supreme Court Bench to Hear Challenges Against Privacy Legislation
item.description: A panel of three judges led by Chief Justice Surya Kant will review legal challenges brought by media organizations and activists. The hearings for these petitions are slated for October 27.

item.title: Apple Releases Software Update Version 27.2 Featuring New Siri AI Capabilities
item.description: Apple has launched its latest software updates across all device platforms today. The new release incorporates expanded artificial intelligence tools for Siri.

item.title: Lula da Silva Secures Electoral Victory in Brazil
item.description: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has achieved a political comeback by winning the Brazilian presidential election. His victory concludes a hard-fought campaign that drew significant international attention.

item.title: SHRC Demands Oversight of Private Clinics After Kannur Boy's Death
item.description: Following a young boy's death after a tonsil operation in Kannur, the rights panel instructed the health ministry. Authorities must now verify the credentials and registrations of all medical and support personnel at private facilities.

item.title: Key Revelations from Anthropic's IPO Filing
item.description: Anthropic has released a 355-page initial public offering prospectus containing previously confidential details about the firm. The document offers unexpected insights into the company's internal operations and finances.

item.title: Chris Hemsworth Renews Byron Bay Property
item.description: Actor Chris Hemsworth and partner Elsa Pataky transformed their Australian coastal estate into a contemporary residence. The upgraded property features a 50-meter infinity pool, a gym, and a cycling track.

item.title: National Volunteer Force Launched by NCP
item.description: The NCP has formed a new volunteer wing named Jatiya Swechchhasebak Shakti. Approved by convener Nahid Islam and member secretary Akhtar Hossain, the initiative establishes a fresh leadership committee.

item.title: Kochi Authorities Fine 34 School Vehicles
item.description: Enforcement officials in Kochi penalized 34 school buses a total of 57,250 rupees for various violations. The crackdown targeted safety and regulatory non-compliance among the transport providers.

item.title: Texas Couple Evicted After Inheritance Dispute
item.description: A Texas pair failed in their legal attempt to retain 70 acres of historic family property after the mother omitted her son from the will. The court ruling finalized the loss of the land they had occupied for years.

item.title: Kalamassery Signal Work Disrupts Train Schedules
item.description: Engineering tasks at Kalamassery station on October 27 will lead to the partial cancellation of two Vande Bharat services. Additionally, the Mangala Lakshadweep Superfast Express will face a 90-minute delay.

item.title: গুরুতর হাম রোগীদের রাজধানী হাসপাতালে স্থানান্তর

item.title: পল্টনে সিপিবির কার্যালয়ের সামনে হামলা ও বিক্ষোভ

item.title: আইফোন ডুও গ্রাহকদের স্ক্রিন ফাটল নিয়ে অভিযোগ

item.description: প্লাজমা পদার্থবিদ্যার বাইরে ফিশন স্টার্টআপগুলো নতুন এক সমস্যার মুখে পড়েছে। সরকারি তহবিল পাওয়ার শর্ত হিসেবে তাদের শেয়ার ছাড়তে হচ্ছে, অথবা একা কাজ চালিয়ে যেতে হচ্ছে।

item.title: কংগ্রেস সভাপতির মন্তব্যের প্রতিবাদে বিজেপির বিক্ষোভ

item.title: ব্রিস্টল বেয়ার্ডসে যোগ দিলেন তোতোয়া আউভা
item.description: সারাসেনস থেকে বরখাস্ত হওয়ার দুই সপ্তাহ পর ২১ বছর বয়সী সামোয়ান ফরোয়ার্ড তোতোয়া আউভাকে দলে ভিড়িয়েছে ব্রিস্টল বেয়ার্ডস। এর আগে তিনি স্টোকস ও আটকিনস সংঘাতে জড়িয়েছিলেন।

item.title: সার্বিয়ার নির্বাচনে ছাত্র আন্দোলনের অভাবনীয় জয়

item.title: খাড়গের মন্তব্যের নিন্দা জানিয়ে বিজেপির বিক্ষোভ

item.description: Severe cyclonic storm Arnab is projected to hit the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coastline on October 28 morning. Wind speeds may reach up to 140 kmph, prompting warnings in the region.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi to kick off Congress 2027 poll campaign in Punjab
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is set to begin the party's election groundwork in the Malwa region of Punjab. State party chief Pargat Singh confirmed the political launch.

item.title: House Democrats urge special counsel for Trump-Epstein ties
item.description: House Judiciary Committee Democrats released a 53-page document renewing past sexual misconduct claims against Donald Trump. They are calling for a special counsel to investigate his connection to Jeffrey Epstein.
